lead_email.body:
New property valuation lead

A completed property valuation submission has been received.

Contact details

First name{{calculate "String(data.first_name == null || String(data.first_name).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.first_name).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Email{{calculate "String(data.email == null || String(data.email).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.email).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}

Contact requested{{calculate "data.agent_contact_consent === true ? 'Yes' : 'No'"}}

Property details

Province{{calculate "String(data.province == null || String(data.province).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.province).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
City{{calculate "String(data.city == null || String(data.city).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.city).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Suburb{{calculate "String(data.suburb == null || String(data.suburb).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.suburb).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Bedrooms{{calculate "String(data.bedrooms == null || String(data.bedrooms).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.bedrooms).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Bathrooms{{calculate "String(data.bathrooms == null || String(data.bathrooms).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.bathrooms).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Floor area (m²){{calculate "String(data.floor_area == null || String(data.floor_area).trim() === '' ? 'Not provided' : data.floor_area).replaceAll('&', '&').replaceAll('<', '<').replaceAll('>', '>').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(34), '"').replaceAll(String.fromCharCode(39), ''')"}}
Rates and taxes (R per month){{calculate "String(data.rates_and_taxes == null || String(data.rates_and_taxes).trim() === '' ?
